response.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram_gb, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram_gb) AS avg_site_ram_gb, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM site_averages GROUP BY entrystat;
